title: Prove canonical score and playback parity
acceptance: Demonstrate parity with meaningful compiler/playback tests.

evidence.note: Approved delivery direction; unchecked milestones do not imply missing all underlying code.

Branch composer/parity: 7 tests on a Current using every visual, a literal passage, non-ASCII text and a span, in all nine themes and none. Every word reaches its atoms in order; clips anchor their passage; span atoms tile their characters; compiles are deterministic and prefix-stable; every atom resolves its passage cue; the live Player presents exactly the compiled atoms. Five mutations each caught. No runtime change.
Parity tests, open for review, not merged.
Merged as #412 and deployed; full validation passed on the branch.
